purpose: Higher-reasoning Sol difficulty calibration and paired feedback-repair versus fresh-retry data collection. No training or downstream training destination.

model.snapshot_limit: Official catalog exposes this model ID rather than an immutable dated snapshot; preserve CLI metadata and cached responses.
model.resolution_note: The requested model and actual CLI flags are cached. The successful CLI events do not report an immutable resolved model snapshot.

sources.origin: Fresh programmatically generated fictional procurement packets; no model directly writes a test packet.
sources.date_filter: Every packet was created after the documented 2026-04-30 Sol cutoff.
sources.independence: All 32 pilot and 1,056 potential main keys agree with two independent rendered-text readers (SQL/Decimal and Fraction), in addition to fixture checks.
sources.limitations: Clean fictional tables, explicit local policy rules, all statuses active, no OCR or missing material. Scenario families share rules and are not causal ablations.

planned_main.contrast: Prior answer plus failed-field flags versus fresh attempt, one high-effort Sol call per arm; no gold values or gold evidence in feedback.

cost_note: 31 recorded request attempts, usage available for 3 completed answers only. Missing and interrupted usage is unknown. Dollar billing is not exposed by this subscription CLI.
service_conclusion: No difficulty level selected, no main originals or repair/retry calls performed. Three usable answers are all correct, but they are an incomplete, service-selected sample, not an accuracy estimate.
protocol_changes: v4b reduced concurrency, required turn.completed, and added immediate service-stop behavior. v4c retained those rules and changed only protocol identity for one declared whole-pilot recovery after cooldown. Sources, instruction wording, scoring, seeds, and selection rules did not change.

source_freeze.preflight: 32 potential pilot packets passed procedural/Decimal, grouped/Fraction, independent text/SQL/Decimal and independent text/Fraction checks. Main sources require fresh audits before main calls.
source_freeze.call_boundary: One CLI subprocess per request, no wrapper retries. Internal CLI network retries cannot be independently disabled or verified.
source_freeze.restart_reason: Whole pilot restarted after systemic429 service failure, without using previous outputs to select cases or difficulty. Prior28requests retained underdata/high_v4_service_attempt.
changes_from_original_freeze: Abort sequential phase immediately on first transport failure; retain exact failed attempt
source_freeze.test_scope: 17fixturetests plus12transport/engine tests including service-stop and terminal-completion checks

rights_note: Code and narrative follow the repository MIT license. Model responses are identified as generated service outputs. This demonstration makes no claim of unrestricted permission to use exported responses for training other models.
historical_preservation: All previous v1, hard_v2, and sol_v3 data and figures are retained byte-for-byte.
